Actually OIML MAA certificates have format like R76/2006-GB1-12.02 where the "1" denotes MAA level. The scheme per schema (A|B): MAA certificates are scheme B under OIML CS. Given "OIML MUTUAL ACCEPTANCE ARRANGEMENT" header, scheme = "B".

Actually MAA certificate format R76/2006-GB1-12.02: the "GB1" is country code + MAA level. The scheme letter under OIML CS: scheme A = certificate without MAA, scheme B = MAA certificate.
